turns.text: Hi, Vikram calling from PayFlex. Before we start — this call may be recorded and I'm using an AI assistant to help me pull up accurate information. Is that alright with you?

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I'm not interested. And please don't call me about this again.

turns.speaker: agent
